title: [COMMUNITY PUBLISHER] Adds 6 people to the publisher list
author: gggff123

gist.summary: Added KT-Society, connor11016, Maliot100X, papa-pichita, sonofstrange, and specrz to the GitHub ID allowlist for community model publishing. These six accounts can use the community publisher access check.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli adds six name tags to a lime green (#ecf874) community publisher board beside sprouting code-plants; she wears a tiny tool belt and is a small yellow bee with dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
